text:
Anya: heads-up — bringing up polaris19b (int4) on canary fleet, seeing weird OOMs when batch_size >= 6.
Ben: which config are you running?
Anya: default canary config:
```json
{"batch_size": 6, "max_new_tokens": 128, "kv_prefetch": true, "quant": "int4", "slot_reserve": 0.05}
```
Carmen: any sign of memory fragmentation or steady growth?
Anya: yes — memory usage looks stable early, then sudden jump during multi-turn prompts and OOM. dmesg shows: "oom_reaper: frame reclaimed but allocation failed" and runtime logs show repeated alloc failures in kv-cache codepath.
Jia: can you paste the runtime trace snippet?
Anya: log:
```
2026-03-18T10:12:03Z ERROR runtime: alloc failed size=67108864 arena=3
2026-03-18T10:12:03Z WARN  kv_cache: eviction triggered, scanned_slots=2048
2026-03-18T10:12:03Z ERROR model: OOM when allocating KV cache for new tokens
```
Ben: that pattern usually means fragmentation + large contiguous allocation request. With int4 we may pack more, but allocator still needs big slabs.
Carmen: have you tried lowering max_new_tokens or reducing batch? sometimes set max_new_tokens default to 64 for these medium-long models.
Anya: tried batch 4 -> stable so far, but we don't want to degrade throughput on heavy prompt workloads.
Jia: two quick experiments:
1) set max_new_tokens default to 64 for polaris19b canary
2) enable kv_compaction_hook (experimental) to coalesce small free blocks before large allocs
Anya: ran both — compaction reduced fragmentation but CPU jitter spiked ~8%. Quality check: with max_new_tokens 64, very few regressions on our eval set (bleu/lookups). one failure on long-form summarization (~1.8% drop at extreme tail)
Ben: quant quality parity? int4 seemed close?
Anya: int4 top-p metrics within 0.6% on average, tail cases hit by max_new_tokens change, not quant.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for polaris19b-int4/slot-a at 2535678920 :rocket:
Carmen: propose interim defaults: batch_size_limit=5, max_new_tokens=64, kv_prefetch=false, enable kv_compaction on canary only. Schedule A/B for 24h and run eval harness against long-format prompts.
Jia: agree. Also add a dashboard metric for fragmentation: "heap_holes_ratio" and kv_compaction_runs counter.
Anya: I'll push a patch to the canary config and kick off A/B. patch: config diff:
```diff
- "batch_size": 6
- "max_new_tokens": 128
- "kv_prefetch": true
+ "batch_size": 5
+ "max_new_tokens": 64
+ "kv_prefetch": false
+ "kv_compaction": "on_canary"
```
Ben: if A/B shows <1% productivity loss and OOMs disappear, we can roll to dedicated pools with a staged canary.
Carmen: also create a follow-up ticket to test slab allocator tuning (increase min_contiguous_block) and try slot_reserve bump from 5%->8% for polaris family.
Anya: filing ticket now and attaching canary logs. Thanks — will update after 6h run. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary health ok at 2535678960 — 30min checks passed, no OOMs seen yet.
